title: Trigonometry
tagline: Sine, cosine and tangent in right-angled triangles.

skills.title: Trigonometric ratios
skills.objective: Write sin, cos and tan from the sides of a right-angled triangle.

skills.title: Exact values
skills.objective: Know sin, cos and tan of 0°, 30°, 45°, 60° and 90° where they're simple.

skills.title: Using trigonometry
skills.objective: Find a side from the hypotenuse and an angle.

levels.title: Sine, Cosine and Tangent
levels.objective: Write each ratio as a fraction of two sides.

lesson.intro: In a right-angled triangle, each angle has an opposite side, an adjacent side and the hypotenuse.
steps: The hypotenuse is the longest side, opposite the right angle.
sin = opposite ÷ hypotenuse, cos = adjacent ÷ hypotenuse, tan = opposite ÷ adjacent.
Remember it as SOH CAH TOA.

example.question: Opposite 7, adjacent 24, hypotenuse 25. Write tan A.
example.note: 7 and 24 share no factor, so it's in its lowest terms.

levels.title: Common Angles
levels.objective: Know the exact values that are whole numbers or halves. All angles are in degrees.

lesson.intro: Some angles have values worth knowing by heart.
steps: sin 0° = 0 and cos 90° = 0. tan 90° has no value at all.

example.question: Work out 4 cos 60° + sin 90°
example.note: Angles here are always in degrees.

lesson.remember: sin 30° and cos 60° are both one half.

levels.title: Triangle Challenge
levels.objective: Use the ratios and the exact values to find sides.

lesson.intro: Multiply the hypotenuse by the right ratio to find a side.
steps: Opposite = hypotenuse × sin of the angle.
Adjacent = hypotenuse × cos of the angle.

example.question: Hypotenuse 14 cm, angle 30°. Find the opposite side.

lesson.remember: Pick the ratio with the side you want.
